1
Sajjad Oh Quran Aye Kazmi Brothers Lyrics In Punjabi
Sabraan Te Jeenday Loko Tauheed V Hairan Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Ronda Rehya Lahu Jo Dardaan Da Aasman Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Akbar Tere Jigar Da Khon Athro Ban Ke Aaya Sajjad Di Akhaan Choon.
Beemar Ainu Kar Gayi Akbar Teri Azan Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Tafseer Ais Quraan Di Darbar Sar Barehna Khutbay V Parhdi Rayi Aye.
Parh Ke Jeenday Musayab Ronda Aye Kul Jahan Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Shabeer Ne Si Asghar Nu Qabar Wich Lahaya Dafnai Taun Sakina.
Wasda Si Jenda Wehra Oh Ho Gaya Veeran Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Haye Surkh Wich Bazaraan Aida Ghilaf Hoya Pathraan Da Meen Jo Wasya.
Choti Jeendi Sakina Mar Gayi Sar-e-Zindan Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Ik Raat Okhi Aayi Laila Ne Waal Kholay Zainab V Rondi Rayi Aye.
Akbar Bhira De Qatil Da Banriya Mezban Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Babay De Te Bhirawaan De Tukriyaan Nu Aa Ke Sajjad Dafan Kita.
Ho Gaye Ne Ais Sabar Te Kul Anbiya Hairan Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Seene Che Matami De Qabar-e-Hussain Hai Jo Sajjad Di Atta Aye.
Har Matami Di Jag Te Jo Zaat Nigehban Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
Akhiyaan Choon Khon Toon V Jo Sham Wich Wahaya Oh Deen Di Baqa Aye.
Taun Oh Kitab Jenda ALLAH V Naat Khuwan Aye Sajjad Oh Quran Aye.
 Qambar Jay Khon Roye Haq Aye Ada Nahin Honraan Sajjad De Ghama Da.
Jeenday Janazay Te Khud Zahra V Noha Khuwan Aye Sajjad Our Quran Aye.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 20 verses in Shahmukhi Panjabi and verified the verse count and stanza alignment against `romanLyrics`. Updated the title and script metadata and cleared the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the final Roman “Our” as **اوہ**, consistent with the repeated refrain, and retained “Our” in `romanLyrics`.
